raw_capture_reconstruction: 20/20 bit-exact arrays from published generator parameters and noise seed
paired_noise_test: Same independently sampled analog operating point, two independent noise draws, static ADC simulation, frozen model. Constant gain normalization only; no filtering or spectral subtraction.
known_parameter_inverse: Exact fixed stage gains, DAC offsets and cubic terms, backend quantizer bin midpoint. Contains original input noise and backend quantization error. Not accessible to the trained model.
